permission_closed_note: permission_closed_over_armed_cycles = permission_closed_cycles / armed_cycles; permission_closed_cycles is measured in the armed billing interval and common_window_cycles is a different interval, so they are never divided; the ratio is not an actual ADMIT-blocked/stall period and not a V-window wait ratio
pooling_note: no cross-launch, no cross-phase and no old-E2 pooling; calibration groups are split by candidate_id and per-run candidate evidence is in runs.tsv
